# <span id="aanchor246"></span> HC Property Source Document Editor

Accessing this form requires **Application Process - FLOWCAL Options** privileges.

Use the HC Property Source Document Editor to list source documents containing the physical constants used for hydrocarbon components, such as water, CO, ethane and cyclopentane. The source may be a published standard, company literature or any other data source.

These source documents will be available for selection in the Source Document column of the [Hydrocarbon Properties Editor](../../Source%20Analysis/Hydrocarbon%20Properties/Hydrocarbon%20Properties.md).

<div class="procedure">

To access the HC Property Source Document Editor and add a new source document:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**.
2.  Select **HC Property Source** within the **Application** group.
3.  Click the **New** button.
4.  Enter the document name and click **Save**.

To edit an existing source document:

1.  Select the document name and click **Edit**.
2.  Make the necessary changes and click **Save**.
